export.description: Choose what to export and generate a JSON file.
export.includeSecretsDescription: Exports API keys, TLS certificates, and other secrets in plain text. Keep the file secure.
export.secretsWarning: The export contains plain-text secrets. Anyone with this file can use your accounts.

agentBackend.description: Configure agent execution engines and their models. Runtime options such as working directory and permission mode are configured per agent in Organization → Agent.
agentBackend.title: Agent Backends

appearance.description: Theme and language preferences are saved on this device.
appearance.title: Appearance

localProxy.description: Configure the app's built-in LLM Gateway. claudecode and codex subprocesses send HTTP requests here; the app authenticates them with a temporary token and forwards requests to the real LLM provider without exposing secrets outside the app.
localProxy.title: Local HTTP Proxy

llmProvider.description: Configure available model sources. After saving, Agentre can fetch the models available under the account and fill in each model's capabilities automatically.

gapBanner.description: Some agents are bound to backends that have no activated LLM provider. Once you've configured a provider, go to the org chart to assign it to those agents.
gapBanner.title: Some agents still need this

llmProvider.title: LLM Providers

notifications.pageDesc: Get notified when a conversation finishes, fails, or needs your input.
notifications.masterDesc: Master switch — turning this off disables every method below.
notifications.enableDesc: Alert you when a turn finishes.
notifications.onlyWhenUnfocusedLabel: Only when app is in background
notifications.onlyWhenUnfocusedDesc: On by default; turn off to also be notified when the app is focused but the finished session isn't the one you're viewing.
notifications.channelsDesc: When the alert condition is met, notify via any method enabled below.
notifications.systemDesc: Posts to macOS Notification Center / Windows Action Center — visible even when the app is in the background.
notifications.toastDesc: Pop a toast in the bottom-right of the app (only visible while the app is focused).
notifications.ruleDesc: By default you're only notified when the app is in the background; turn off the switch above to also be notified while focused on a different session. Done, error, and needs-input all notify; ones you stop manually don't.

nav.agentBackendDot: Some agents don't have a backend yet
nav.llmProviderDot: Some backends are missing an activated LLM provider

mcpServers.description: The MCP server configuration view is reserved for managing connections, authorization, and available tools.
mcpServers.title: MCP Servers

skillsTools.description: The skills and tools management view is reserved for enabling, disabling, and configuring agent capabilities.
skillsTools.title: Skills / Tools

flash.savedButStopped: Settings saved, but the proxy did not start: {{reason}}

listener.description: All LLM requests from claudecode / codex subprocesses arrive here. The app routes them to real LLM providers with tokens.
listener.portHint: Default 52401. Use 0 for a random port on each launch.
listener.title: Listener

routes.description: Requests are forwarded after temporary token verification. Tokens live only in memory during tests or runtime.
routes.mcpReserved: Reserved local MCP service entry point (404 when no service is registered)
routes.title: Exposed Routes

security.description: Real LLM provider secrets stay in main-process memory. CLI subprocesses receive temporary tokens issued by the app. Tokens are valid for only 60 seconds, revoked immediately after tests, and never written to .env, config, or process args.
security.title: Secrets Stay in the App
